parameters.name: healthy_32p4_SAFEon_COV1n
parameters.source: ideal 1800W regenerative injection; full 1s even after OVP/BREAK_N as a conservative dump-energy screen
parameters.chopper: 2x2ohm parallel, 11.25mohm Q7 channel (4.5mOhm max at VGS=4.5V times hot factor 2.5) with separate resistor-bank and Q7 energy integrals, 10ohm/10nF gate, hysteretic comparator behavior model
parameters.regen_ramp: linear 0-to-1800W over 1ms avoids an unphysical step through bulk ESL; full requested energy still approximately 1.8kJ over 1s
parameters.comparator: TLV1704 threshold network; VOL=0.9V behavior boundary; no official macromodel or worst-case delay; measured crossing times are from behavior-level comparator, without datasheet propagation delay
parameters.netlist_scope: independent average 1s DC-link network, not a full inverter/FOC test
